name: codex-paper-factory
description: Codex PaperFactory: long-horizon research automation with durable logs, phase gates, a Chinese agent-style Web UI, scientific figures, and conference-paper drafting checkpoints.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a research task into auditable experiments, figures, and paper drafts.
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin for turning an initial research task into a long-running, auditable paper-production workflow: scope, literature survey, baseline matrix, data sanity, experiments, ablations, scientific figures, conference-paper drafting, internal review, a Chinese agent-style local Web UI, detached background runs, Codex-authored progress updates, selectable memory, human intervention notes, and automated top-conference-style manuscript review after paper drafting.
defaultPrompt: Run autonomous research on this topic for one week.
Resume the research project and advance the next gate.
Create paper-ready figures and a conference draft from evidence.
Audit my manuscript and prepare citation/data availability checks.
Generate a PaperFactory dashboard and next-step prompt.
Open the interactive PaperFactory Web UI and monitor Codex-authored progress.
